# external-dns

external-dns, publishing routed hostnames into the lab's zone over RFC2136.

<!-- Generated by nix/floe-interface.nix. Refresh: nix run .#refresh-floe-docs -->

## Inputs

| input | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| chart | string | *(required)* | Store path of the external-dns Helm chart. Required. |
| defaultTargets | list of string | `[]` | Addresses every record points at, regardless of what the object says.  A lab behind one ingress needs this: the LoadBalancer address a k3d Service reports is a cluster-internal address that nothing outside can reach.  |
| interval | string | `"1m"` | How often the reconcile loop runs when nothing has happened. |
| namespace | string | `"external-dns"` | Namespace the controller runs in. |
| policy | one of "sync", "upsert-only", "create-only" | `"sync"` | `sync` creates, updates and deletes. It is the only one that keeps the zone honest, and the only one that needs the teardown step: a record this controller created outlives the cluster otherwise.  |
| sources | list of string | `["service","ingress","gateway-httproute","gateway-tlsroute"]` | Object kinds to derive records from. |
| tsigKeyname | string | `"externaldns-key"` | TSIG key name the server knows this client by. |
| tsigSecretAlg | one of "hmac-sha256", "hmac-sha512", "hmac-sha1" | `"hmac-sha256"` | TSIG algorithm. Must match what the server is configured with. |
| tsigSecretRef | string | *(required)* | `<namespace>/<name>` of a Secret with a `tsig-secret` key holding the base64 TSIG secret. Required.  A reference rather than the value: external-dns reads it from `EXTERNAL_DNS_RFC2136_TSIG_SECRET`, so it never has to appear in a rendered manifest.  |

## Requires

| hole | signature | what it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| cluster | KUBERNETES_CLUSTER | The cluster a member installs into: its name, version, context and address ranges. |
| gatewayApi | GATEWAY_API | The Gateway API CRDs are registered, so Gateway and route kinds have types. |
| zone | DNS_ZONE | The lab's DNS zone and the server authoritative for it. The only fully portable signature. |
